title: ProEtaleDirectImageMateCompatibility
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a discrete commutative ring and $g:X\to Y$ a scheme morphism. On bounded-below derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], put $a=\nu_Y^*$, $b=\nu_X^*$, $l=g_e^*$, $r=Rg_{e,*}$, $p=g_p^*$, $t=Rg_{p,*}$, with the canonical derived adjunctions $l\dashv r$ and $p\dashv t$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-proetale-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-direct-image, def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Let $c:pa\xrightarrow{\sim}bl$ be the exact localization of the canonical inverse-image comparison, and let $\beta:ar\to tb$ be the specified right-derived etale/pro-etale base-change transformation. For every object $A$ of $D^+(Y_e,\Lambda)$ and $B$ of $D^+(X_e,\Lambda)$, the specified maps satisfy $\beta_{lA}\circ a(\eta^e_A)=t(c_A)\circ\eta^p_{aA}$ and $\varepsilon^p_{bB}\circ p(\beta_B)=b(\varepsilon^e_B)\circ c_{rB}$. Here $\eta^e,\varepsilon^e,\eta^p,\varepsilon^p$ are the respective derived units and counits. There is no quasi-compactness, quasi-separatedness or finiteness hypothesis.

source.place: Opening sentences: the canonical comparison is adjoint to the inverse-image square followed by the etale counit and is compatible with units and counits

proof.text: Apply Mathlib iterated_mateEquiv_conjugateEquiv_symm to the four ordinary inverse-image/direct-image adjunctions. It identifies the mate of the specified pullback comparison with lowerStarComparisonUpperStarBaseChange. Apply the exact functors termwise to bounded-below complexes and localize. The composition and natural-isomorphism factorization equations for mapDerivedCategoryPlus show that directImageComparisonPullbackPlusIso is the localized ordinary square. Adjunction.derivedPlus_mateEquiv_app_fac computes its derived mate after the unit of the right-derived etale direct image. The defining factorization of rightDerivedFunctorPlusBaseChange gives the identical formula for comparisonDirectImageCanonicalMate. Uniqueness of transformations out of that right-derived functor identifies these maps. Mathlib unit_mateEquiv and mateEquiv_counit then give the two displayed equations. The equation derivedAdjunctionPlus_eq_derivedPlus identifies the recorded adjunctions; no finiteness or qcqs condition is used in this normalization, and zero categories satisfy the same identities.

theorem directImageMateCompatibility
    (Λ : Type u) [CommRing Λ] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) :
    (∀ A : DerivedCategory.Plus
          (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} Λ))),
        (comparisonUpperStar
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} Λ)) Y).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map
            ((Etale.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction
              (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} Λ)) g).derivedAdjunctionPlus.unit.app A) ≫
          (comparisonDirectImageCanonicalMate (ULift.{u + 1, u} Λ) g).app
            ((Etale.upperStar
              (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} Λ)) g).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj A) =
        (ProEtale.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} Λ)) g).derivedAdjunctionPlus.unit.app
            ((comparisonUpperStar
              (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} Λ)) Y).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj A) ≫
          (ProEtale.lowerStar
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} Λ)) g).rightDerivedFunctorPlus.map
              ((directImageComparisonPullbackPlusIso (ULift.{u + 1, u} Λ) g).hom.app A)) ∧
    (∀ B : DerivedCategory.Plus
          (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} Λ))),
        (ProEtale.upperStar
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} Λ)) g).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map
            ((comparisonDirectImageCanonicalMate (ULift.{u + 1, u} Λ) g).app B) ≫
          (ProEtale.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} Λ)) g).derivedAdjunctionPlus.counit.app
              ((comparisonUpperStar
                (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} Λ)) X).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj B) =
        (directImageComparisonPullbackPlusIso (ULift.{u + 1, u} Λ) g).hom.app
          ((Etale.lowerStar
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} Λ)) g).rightDerivedFunctorPlus.obj B) ≫
          (comparisonUpperStar
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} Λ)) X).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map
              ((Etale.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction
                (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} Λ)) g).derivedAdjunctionPlus.counit.app B))
